name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Followed the vendor's instructions from https://elevenlabs.io/docs/quickstart: installed the elevenlabs SDK and python-dotenv, created the example script using the exact API call pattern shown (text_to_speech.convert with voice_id JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb, model_id eleven_v3, output_format mp3_44100_128), and verified text-to-speech generates a valid audio file. The generated output.mp3 is 46,019 bytes and confirmed by `file` command as a valid MPEG ADTS layer III MP3 at 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, monaural. The API key was sourced from the pre-exported ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable as instructed.
deviations: The quickstart's original example.py calls `play(audio)` which requires MPV/ffmpeg and plays through speakers. In the sandbox (no audio output), I created a second script that saves the audio iterator to a file instead, which is the standard way to verify audio generation in a headless environment. The core API call and SDK usage remain exactly as documented.

verified.evidence: output.mp3: Audio file with ID3 version 2.4.0, contains: MPEG ADTS, layer III, v1, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, Monaural
